quote: CMA Terminals, in partnership with local pure players and international investors, is a shareholder and contributor to the development of the new facility of Puerto Antioquia. … Construction of the terminal began in 2022. … a 3.8-kilometer viaduct connects the onshore yard to an offshore platform capable of accommodating up to five container vessels simultaneously. … The terminal’s expected annual handling capacity includes: 650,000 TEUs per year … To support efficient and sustainable operations, the terminal is equipped with: 3 Ship-to-Shore (STS) cranes and 8 electric Rubber-Tired Gantry (RTG) cranes
note: Opened CMA CGM 11 Feb 2026 (Puerto Antioquia shareholder + first call).
